text.firstObservation: The crested razorbeak is the same animal that works the tideline, grown into the terrace precinct's apex holder: heavier through the shoulders, its bright crest raised, and entirely unwilling to give ground on the processional stone.

notes: Habitats::black_beach_vertical_slice defines this creature only as a Beast on habitat.black_beach.terrace_precinct's roster from day 1, not night-only. It is a razorbeak variant -- world.rs already draws "bright-crested" as one of the razorbeak's physical variants -- so this record derives from enemy.raptor.razorbeak and overrides exactly what the fixture and content/loot/razorbeak.crested.prototype.json name: the ID and the display name. Nothing else is overridden because the fixture overrides nothing else.

derivesFrom is resolved once, by tools/src/validate.mjs and tools/src/build-content-bundle.mjs, so the razorbeak's stats, skills, actions, recovery-opening rules, world presence, intent tells and art placeholder have one owner and cannot drift between the two records.

level is deliberately NOT 9. A habitat's base_level is a region level, not a creature level: the tideline is base_level 5 and its razorbeak is level 7. Reading base_level as this creature's level would have invented a number.
